text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Astonishing! Even trainers of legend<n>have never
won every G1 race!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Well done! Your feats will be<n>remembered here
for generations to<n>come, you legend of Tracen
Academy!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Th-these tears of joy! You should receive<n>the
highest of accolades for the<n>marvelous bond
you've formed with your<n>racers.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I really can't thank you enough... for<n>seeing my
dream to fruition!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Well then, shall we continue to marvel at<n>the
pristine glitter of a chamber<n>brimming with
trophies?
